headline: Marathon Nextgen Realty Limited: Scheme of Arrangement
sum: Scheme of Arrangement — Marathon Nextgen Realty Limited has informed the Exchange about the Notice of NCLT convened meeting of the Equity Shareholders and the Unsecured Creditors of the Company to be held on Monday, September 7, 2026 at…
detail: Scheme of Arrangement — Marathon Nextgen Realty Limited has informed the Exchange about the Notice of NCLT convened meeting of the Equity Shareholders and the Unsecured Creditors of the Company to be held on Monday, September 7, 2026 at 11:00 am and 12:30 p.m. respectively, pursuant to the order dated July 2, 2026 passed by the Hon'ble National Company Law Tribunal, Mumbai Bench
